checks.good: Every screen you reach has a visible way back and a gesture back, and both return you where you were.
checks.name: the way back

checks.good: Every sidebar, popover and menu goes away with a tap outside it, and once you pick something in it.
checks.name: overlay dismissal

checks.good: One tap anywhere on a control works, every time, with no second try.
checks.name: tap landing

checks.good: A tap that starts slow work (a download, a load, a sign-in) finishes what you asked for when the work is done; you never tap it twice.
checks.name: one action finishes the intent

checks.good: A jump (a contents entry, a search hit, a scrubber drop) lands on its target within its budget, with no further tap.
checks.name: a jump lands on its own, on time

checks.good: Every button, link and tab is at least 44 by 44 points, so a tap lands where you aim.
checks.name: every target is big enough to hit

principles.name: your intent is the unit
principles.promise: What you meant takes one go: one tap lands, one tap finishes what it started, and every way in has a way back out.

checks.good: Reopen, relaunch or turn the device and you are exactly where you were.
checks.name: place stability

checks.good: A stray tap (the middle, the top edge), an edge swipe that goes nowhere, a swipe across and back, dismissing a sheet or leaving the app never moves your place.
checks.name: place kept through stray input

checks.good: After you move, your place stays where you put it: no late restore, re-sent jump or sync landing moves it again.
checks.name: navigation that fights you

principles.name: your place is yours
principles.promise: Where you are reading or working stays put through relaunches, turns, stray touches and late replies.

checks.good: Every control and what you read sits wholly inside the window, in every orientation and after turning the device and back; no header, bar or control covers the text or sits under the status bar.
checks.name: inside the window

checks.good: Nothing pans on an axis it doesn't scroll, and no content is wider or taller than its viewport on an axis that is fixed, in every pose.
checks.name: viewport holds still

checks.good: Glass and overlays float over the content: it runs underneath them, never shrinks or is cropped to make room, and its end can always be brought clear of them.
checks.name: chrome floats over content

checks.good: A jump's target (a search hit, a linked passage, a chosen chapter) lands wholly inside the window and under no chrome.
checks.name: what you asked for lands in clear view

checks.good: A banner or notice never stays over what you read: the content makes room for it, or it goes once you act or wait.
checks.name: a notice gets out of the way

principles.name: the content is the canvas
principles.promise: What you read fills its space and stays there: inside the window, still on every axis it doesn't scroll, and never covered or crowded out by chrome.

checks.good: In every fold posture nothing you read runs across the fold, and a device held open like a book shows a page on each side of it.
checks.name: content clears the fold

checks.good: A few seconds after the device turns, folds or unfolds, the screen is laid out as a fresh launch in that posture lays it out: nothing lingers, nothing is missing.
checks.name: a turn lays out like a fresh launch

checks.good: After a turn, the first words on screen are within a line of the first words before it, however you scrolled since the last turn.
checks.name: your place survives a turn

principles.name: posture changes re-lay out in place
principles.promise: When the device turns, folds or unfolds, the screen lays out as if it had launched that way: nothing lingers from the old shape, nothing runs across the fold, and your place stays where it was.

checks.good: Each piece of content is on screen once; nothing shows a ghost copy mid-transition.
checks.name: double-draw

checks.good: Once something lands it stays put; nothing nudges it afterwards.
checks.name: jump after landing

checks.good: Bars and controls hand over in one beat: never two states at once, never a blank between them.
checks.name: late or lingering chrome

checks.good: Things that move travel there; nothing teleports across the screen.
checks.name: snap with no transition

checks.good: The screen comes to rest promptly after you act.
checks.name: settle time

checks.good: Each thing changes once on its way to where it ends; nothing flips back and forth before it settles, and with no input nothing changes at all.
checks.name: flicker

checks.good: Motion runs at the display's pace with no visible stall.
checks.name: hitches

checks.good: Through a turn or a jump the screen rests only on the old view, the new one or a plain veil: never a stretched, squeezed, shrunken or blended picture, a band, or another page.
checks.name: the screen shows only the before, the after or a veil

principles.name: motion and chrome never surprise
principles.promise: Nothing moves unbidden: things move once, on purpose, at the display's pace, and the screen only ever shows where it was or where it is going. No ghost, no jump, no snap, no flicker, no stall.
